import sys, json, subprocess, random, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import exact_ref as R, fuzz as F, fuzz2 as F2

rng=random.Random(11)
wide=[]
tried=0
while len(wide)<3 and tried<20000:
    tried+=1
    rib, ixps = F2.gen(rng, False)
    core, scopes, rounds, finals = F2.core_of(rib, ixps)
    if not (5 <= len(core) <= 8): continue
    perm = F.find_order(scopes, len(core))
    if perm is not None: continue
    # provably no width-4 order (find_order brute-forces for m<=7)
    if len(core) > 7: continue
    wide.append({'version':1,'ixps':ixps,'rib':[{'path':p,'count':c} for p,c in rib],
                 'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[[c[0],c[1]] for c in core],'queries':[]})
    print('WIDE case core', core, 'scopes', scopes)
print('tried', tried)
json.dump(wide, open('/workspace/dev/wide.json','w'))
for doc in wide:
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True)
